title: S0: held-out ground truth for the Python gate (click 7.1.2)
description: ADR 0008 / DEC-303 (a2): commit the click 7.1.2 candidate list, then the blind-checked classification, scoring mapping and conventions and provenance bundle, before any analyzer run. Gates every analyzer run.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Candidate list committed before the classification file (file history shows the order)
Classification, exclusions with their share, mapping and conventions and a provenance bundle committed before any analyzer run
At least 62 true sites, or the repository declared unsuitable per the pre-registered fork
Blind second-reader disagreements reported with their count

implementationNotes: Candidate list 2ac429b; batch 0 classified fd0fc6b (81 true sites: 71 direct, 10 inferred; 8 poly; 2 excluded; 45 targets, 33 with a true site, 12 zero-truth). Stopping rule reached at batch 0; batches 1-2 not classified. Pending: blind second-reader comparison on the 30-site seeded sample, S6 mapping, README/ADR landing.
